description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the LeavePeriodService in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It contains unit tests for methods related to leave period calculations, date range retrieval, and configuration validation within the leave management module.

classes.name: LeavePeriodServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the LeavePeriodService functionalities including date range calculations and configuration validations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the LeavePeriodService instance before each test.

methods.name: testGetListOfMonths
methods.description: Tests that the getListOfMonths method returns all months of the year accurately.

methods.name: testGetListOfDates
methods.description: Verifies that getListOfDates correctly returns date ranges for each month, including edge cases like February and invalid months.

methods.name: testGetLeavePeriodDao
methods.description: Checks that the getLeavePeriodDao method returns an instance of LeavePeriodDao.

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriodStartDateAndMonth
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of current leave period start date and month, including cache behavior and handling null results.

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriodWhenNotDefined
methods.description: Ensures that when leave period configuration is not defined, the method returns null.

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriod
methods.description: Tests fetching the current leave period when the configuration is defined, mocking date and helper services.

methods.name: testGetNormalizedCurrentLeavePeriod
methods.description: Validates that the normalized form of the current leave period returns expected date strings.

methods.name: testGetMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDateWhenLeavePeriodNotDefined
methods.description: Checks that the method returns null when leave period is not configured.

methods.name: testGetMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDate
methods.description: Data-driven test to verify the maximum allowed leave period end date considering different current dates and start dates.
